map.ABCD2评分用于TIA患者的早期风险分层。低风险患者可门诊随访；中高风险患者建: The ABCD2 score is used for early risk stratification in TIA patients. Low-risk patients can be followed up as outpatients; moderate-to-high-risk patients are advised inpatient evaluation with head/neck vascular imaging and cardiac workup. Score ≥4 warrants active etiology search and intervention. Note: ABCD2 does not apply to confirmed stroke, only for post-TIA risk prediction.

map.年龄 55(+0)、血压正常(+0)、言语障碍不伴无力(+1)、<10min(+: Age 55(+0), normal BP(+0), speech disturbance without weakness(+1), <10min(+0), no DM(+0): total 1 (low risk).
map.0~3 低危、4~5 中危、6~7 高危；高分需尽快影像与抗栓。: 0~3 low, 4~5 moderate, 6~7 high; high scores need prompt imaging and antithrombotic therapy.
map.年龄≥60=1；血压≥140/90=1；临床偏瘫=2（言语=1）；症状≥60mi: Age≥60=1; BP≥140/90=1; clinical hemiparesis=2 (speech=1); symptom≥60min=2 (10~59min=1); diabetes=1.
